partners.mechanism_chain: LORICRIN (HGNC:6932) —DISRUPTS→ Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351); Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351) —LEADS_TO→ Ichthyosis (HP:0000971); YAP1 (HGNC:15066) —DISRUPTS→ Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351); Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351) —LEADS_TO→ Cleft lip (HP:0000204); Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes (GO:0006351) —LEADS_TO→ Uveal coloboma (HP:0000507). Mutations in LORICRIN cause loss-of-function, disrupting the normal transcriptional regulation of developmental genes and leading to Ichthyosis. Similarly, mutations in YAP1 cause loss-of-function, impacting the same transcriptional network and resulting in uveal coloboma, cleft lip, and intellectual disability. The shared disruption of the 'Transcriptional regulation of developmental genes' pathway serves as the mechanistic link.
